steps: No medicine is a capsule; some capsules are tablets; some tablets are laptops
I: capsules and laptops need not meet, so I does not follow
II: the tablets that are capsules are not medicines, so not all tablets can be medicines: follows
check_code:
from itertools import product
# regions over sets M(edicine),C(apsule),T(ablet),L(aptop): enumerate which regions are non-empty
regions=list(product([0,1],repeat=4))
regions=[r for r in regions if any(r)]
import itertools
I_can_fail=False; II_always=True
for mask in range(1<<len(regions)):
    ne=[regions[i] for i in range(len(regions)) if mask>>i&1]
    if any(r[0] and r[1] for r in ne): continue
    if not any(r[1] and r[2] for r in ne): continue
    if not any(r[2] and r[3] for r in ne): continue
    if not any(r[1] and r[3] for r in ne): I_can_fail=True
    if not any(r[2] and not r[0] for r in ne): II_always=False
opts={'A':(False,False),'B':(False,True),'C':(True,True),'D':(True,False)}
res=(not I_can_fail, II_always)
fit=[k for k,v in opts.items() if v==res]
assert fit==['B']
